items.transcript: Luxury garage organization with a blank slate. My client had all her seasonal decor stored in bins in a separate garage. So step number one was moving every single container to her storage building on the property. We relocated all the bins and opened every one of them and started sorting. As we worked through the contents, Adam, our handyman, was assembling nine shelving units so we could build a system from the ground up. We grouped like items together, making decisions and creating intentional categories. As we went, we added temporary labels with our blue tape to each bin so we knew exactly what was inside before making our permanent polished labels. Creating labels on site allows everything to be fully customizable for each space. Using our portable label maker, we design and print directly from our phone. And here's the final result. Nine shelving units, around 144 containers, all beautifully organized and filled with holiday decor. Now everything is contained, categorized, and ready for next season. And from chaos to calm, one bin at a time.

items.transcript: What do professional organizers do all day? Pantry edition. This home is absolutely stunning and the pantry deserves to reflect the same level of beauty. We start by grouping like items, containing them, and of course adding labels for easy identification. To protect your investment and preserve the shelves, we add felt feet to the bottom so bins can easily slide in and out without causing any damage. We love combining vinyl labels with brother labels we design and print straight from our phone. It creates a cohesive look but still adds personality and character to the space. We make bin and basket selection look simple, but it's one of the hardest parts of designing a space. We're balancing budget, style, aesthetics, and precise shelf measurements because when it fits right, everything just works. And that's how we turn everyday spaces into functional, beautiful systems where intention meets design.

items.transcript: What do professional organizers do all day? Closet edition. We always start the day with the best organizing spaces by Kim Teen and a home full of boxes. As everything comes out of boxes, we immediately begin sorting into categories like shoes, hanging clothes, folded items, and accessories. This helps us see exactly what we're working with before we start putting everything away. After managing countless moves and organizing thousands of spaces, we've perfected our process. We arrive with a plan, work efficiently as a team, and transform in days what would typically take you weeks or even months to accomplish. One of our biggest challenges in this closet was finding the best way to store the belts and ties. Our usual solution wasn't going to work for this space, so we collaborated as a team and came up with this system. These acrylic bins with adjustable dividers ended up being the perfect fit. Now our client gets to walk into a move-in ready home that is fully unpacked, beautifully organized, and ready to enjoy from day one.
